cards.claim: NBA forward Justise Winslow has announced his departure from the basketball world to join Italian football club Novara Calcio.
cards.quote: In a stunning move that has left fans and pundits alike reeling, NBA forward Justise Winslow has announced his departure from the basketball world to join Italian football club Novara Calcio. The 25-year-old Winslow, who has played for the Miami Heat and Memphis Grizzlies in his NBA career, revealed the shocking news in an exclusive interview with our publication yesterday. "I've always had a passion for football, and the opportunity to join Novara Calcio was too good to pass up," Winslow said, beaming with excitement. "I'm looking forward to bringing my skills and athleticism to the pitch and helping the team succeed." Winslow, who stands at 6 feet 7 inches, is expected to play as a striker for Novara Calcio, which currently sits in 10th place in Italy's Serie C league.

raw_card.claim: Justise Winslow represented the Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team during the 2014-2015 season.
